steps.name: Tenacious Sami Mountain Warrior
steps.text: Do we have news on Lazal and the other men who disappeared?

steps.name: Solemn Sami Mountain Warrior
steps.text: Yeah, we can stop searching.

steps.name: Solemn Sami Mountain Warrior
steps.text: Demons have been through here.

steps.name: Solemn Sami Mountain Warrior
steps.text: The ice there has Arts damage. It was a hard fight.

steps.name: Tenacious Sami Mountain Warrior
steps.text: They are all roots of the Frost Maple and respected warriors, but not even their bodies remained?

steps.name: Solemn Sami Mountain Warrior
steps.text: Bad weather is known to befall the icefield.

steps.name: Tenacious Sami Mountain Warrior
steps.text: But this kind of weather has been happening far too often of late.

steps.name: Solemn Sami Mountain Warrior
steps.text: Hadn't Sami long since warned us through Eikthyrnir?

steps.name: Solemn Sami Mountain Warrior
steps.text: Come, we must reinforce the fortifications and keep a close eye on every mountain pass.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: (Logs in notebook) 'We've entered the Fjal Vetrtonn. The current temperature is... 31 degrees below zero.'

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: 'So far, I have yet to find any comms stations within Sami borders... and haven't been able to make contact with Director Maryam's expedition team.'

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: *sigh*... If Professor Mary isn't around, who am I even going to send these notes to? Every time he reads my reports, he points out all the phenomena I should've paid closer attention to...

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: 'We've passed through the local settlement mentioned in previous expedition records: at the foot of the Fjal Vetrtonn, near the edge of the forest.'

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: *huff*... Even though I only lost a single glove, it feels so cold.

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: Need a hand, Magallan?

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Oh, it's alright, Simone. I'm almost done with this report! I'll be ready to leave the shelter and brave the blizzard soon!

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Now where was I? Right...

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: 'The settlement had vanished.'

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: 'I asked Simone—'

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: (Quickly erases)

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: 'I asked an accompanying Sami about this, and it seems that Sami tribes are known to move around.'
Why did they move?

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: I tried looking into it, but couldn't figure anything out.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Simone told me that it was Sami herself. She told them that danger was drawing near and that they had to leave.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: But the climate data we've collected so far aren't all that different from the historical record, and there don't seem to be any changes in long term trends either. So what kind of danger is Sami facing?
Looks like... the Scientific Investigation Section's data... needs to be updated.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Right, Sami is still a blind spot in our knowledge.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: But it seems the Sami really don't like being disturbed.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Professor Mary, you've always wanted to work with them, but haven't been able to.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: It takes so much effort to get our applications processed in Ursus. If we could just find a new path into the icefield through Sami and build more research stations, our expeditions would be so much easier.
Unfortunately... the Sami don't want anyone in the icefield...

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Right...

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Eh?

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Was I just... talking to Professor Mary?

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Simone. Simone!

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: What's the matter?

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: I just—

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: —Do you see a group of people over there? There's too much snow; I can't quite...
Mag...allan...

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: I-Is it really Professor Mary?!

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Simone, I need to head over there for a look!

steps.name: Scientific Investigation Director?
steps.text: Magallan.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: (Ah! It's really you! Thank goodness, I found you guys! I knew you'd be safe!)

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: (Weird... How come I can't speak?)

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: (*huff*... *huff*... My heart's beating too fast... A-Am I trembling? Why?)

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: (No, no, no! I need to stop the Professor and take them back!)

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Professor—

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: —Mmf, mrrmrmff!
Shh.
Don't listen. Don't look. Don't speak.

steps.name: Unfamiliar Girl
steps.text: I don't blame you, Simone. It's been a long time since your last visit. It's no wonder you didn't sense it.

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: Haha... I see, so now I'm a visitor here?

spans.text: Haha... I see, so now I'm a

steps.name: Unfamiliar Girl
steps.text: Not as much as her, but still a visitor. The route you two took hasn't been used for a long time.

steps.name: Unfamiliar Girl
steps.text: *sigh* You're lucky I take this detour every time.

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: So the warriors still haven't accepted you, even now? But the land herself clearly regards you as a beloved child.

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: ...In any case, thank you for your help, Typhon.

steps.name: Typhon
steps.text: Mhm. No need to pay me back.

steps.name: Typhon
steps.text: The food I hid around here is more than enough to last me a few months.

steps.name: Typhon
steps.text: So you said you were heading to the icefield to look for missing southerners?

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: Yes.

steps.name: Typhon
steps.text: Then let me come with you. The missing men must have run into trouble. I'll help you protect them.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Uh—Um—Eh, I can talk now...? Is it okay if I talk?

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Listen—

steps.name: Typhon
steps.text: Don't move.

steps.name: Typhon
steps.text: ...Why are you raising your hands?

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Uh... Because I heard the Sami are very fierce? And they don't like it when others enter the icefield?

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: I-I'm really not plotting anything bad!

steps.name: Typhon
steps.text: Hm? Well, the warriors here are indeed fierce, but I'm no warrior.

steps.name: Typhon
steps.text: Anyway, I woke you up just now with my Arts, but you can still hear the voices, right?

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Mm... Yeah, I can.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: It's okay. I've realized it's a hallucination by now. I'm not stupid enough to keep talking to it.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Right, I should jot this down in my notes, too.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: So do you know what causes these hallucinations? Exhaustion due to the extreme weather? Maybe something in the water that paralyzes the central nervous system?

steps.name: Typhon
steps.text: *sigh*... Come here. Your ear.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: (Whispers) Okay, go ahead and tell me.

steps.name: Typhon
steps.text: Alright, now the other side.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Okay... Huh? Weren't you going to whisper something?

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Did you just rub something on my ears? It felt kinda cold.

steps.name: Typhon
steps.text: Now put this under your tongue and press down on it.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: M-Moss and a ball of mud?

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: I know that explorers sometimes boil leather when they're completely out of food, but I've never considered eating moss in an emergency...

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Alright, Magallan, be brave and give it a shot!

steps.name: Typhon
steps.text: Stop being so suspicious of everything. Just put it in your mouth.

steps.name: Typhon
steps.text: Now you'll only hear your own voice and won't be bothered by those strange noises.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Really? You're so helpful!

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: ...Wait, but won't I be deaf to any environmental dangers, too? It'll also affect my balance when I climb. It's too risky.

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: Don't be afraid. Just trust Typhon.

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: We'll take you somewhere where the snow's not contaminated.

steps.name: Typhon
steps.text: Yeah. We'll give you a hand signal when you can spit the mud out.

steps.name: Typhon
steps.text: Until then, don't talk too loud. You don't want it to hear you.

spans.text: Until then, don't talk too loud. You don't want

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Hmm, alright...
The young explorer suddenly stops and looks in a direction where no one's standing.
The brief pause lasts only two seconds. She quickly follows Typhon's directions and squeezes the mudball into her mouth, as though nothing unusual had happened.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Yeah, I can't hear anything now.

steps.name: Typhon
steps.text: Stop.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Ehh?

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: There's musbeast fur scattered in the snow. It's a kind of detection Arts.

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: Good thing you held Magallan back.

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: We couldn't escape the warriors' eyes, but at the very least our visit seems a little more respectful this way.

steps.name: Typhon
steps.text: Should we have her spit out the mudball? You can fill her in on the situation.

steps.name: Typhon
steps.text: If her plan was to enter the icefield this way, then she probably knows nothing about the northern front.

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: No need. Leave the negotiations to me. Most of these warriors would chase us off with their hammers the moment they hear Columbian or the common tongue.

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: Ah... see?

steps.name: Typhon
steps.text: *sigh* It's the Legion. They aren't going to talk to us.

steps.name: Sami Mountain Scout
steps.text: You, daughter of the Santalla Tree.

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: Greetings, warriors of Treescar.

steps.name: Sami Mountain Scout
steps.text: You're with an outlander.

steps.name: Sami Mountain Scout
steps.text: And... the hunter with the black bow.

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: Indeed.

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: But please don't be so quick to attack. This outlander asks nothing of Sami.

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: We simply seek to enter the endless icefield.
The Sami warriors surround them in silence. They show no intention of backing off.
Though silent, their stances remain unchanged, with their hands on their weapons. Regardless, Santalla seems to know exactly what it is they need to hear.

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: ...I understand. It's against the rules. No one should enter the icefield rashly. You built these high walls not only to keep the icefield's disasters at bay, but also to stop the Sami and wild beasts.

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: But her dear mentor has disappeared in the icefield. She is earnestly trying to rescue someone who is practically family to her, and I hope you can make an exception.
The Sami warriors do not move an inch.

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: ...Please trust us. We will take care of the southerner and prevent her from acting rashly against Sami. She won't become lost, and absolutely won't become your enemy.

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: We are accompanying her in order to take care of any worst case scenarios that might happen to her or the missing men.

steps.name: Sami Mountain Scout
steps.text: ...Trust that black bow, too?

steps.name: Sami Mountain Scout
steps.text: You want us to trust the daughter of a crazed Cyclops?

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: That black bow means nothing. She fights the same enemy as you.

steps.name: Sami Mountain Scout
steps.text: Her mind may be clear, but that doesn't mean her weapon won't bring misfortune.

steps.name: Sami Mountain Scout
steps.text: There was a time when we brought back the belongings of every last fallen warrior, until we realized that the enemy could find us through their contaminated relics.

steps.name: Sami Mountain Scout
steps.text: I'm sure you know this well.

steps.name: Sami Mountain Scout
steps.text: —Simone from under the Santalla Tree.

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: I am a shaman no longer, but if that identity will make you reconsider, then I am more than happy to use it.

steps.name: Sami Mountain Scout
steps.text: There are still many among us who remember the warrior who almost became a Snowpriest. But she ran from her duties, so we do not intend to bring up her past.

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: Her power can still take care of those around her.

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: The team that went missing amounts to more than a dozen men. The northern warriors I know would never turn a blind eye with so many lives on the line.

steps.name: Sami Mountain Scout
steps.text: No.

steps.name: Sami Mountain Scout
steps.text: You must bear the harshness of fate, daughter of the Santalla Tree. Endure it. Do not run away.

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: ...Those are Eikthyrnir's words.

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: Did he... learn something from his divination? About the whole northern realm?

steps.name: Sami Mountain Scout
steps.text: I have no answers for outsiders.

steps.name: Sami Mountain Scout
steps.text: But Eikthyrnir has already led many a warrior south, to inform each tribe of Sami's whispers.

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: I understand.

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: If Sami has made her prophecy, I shan't insist on entering the icefield.

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: But now that it's come to this, we lack the supplies to head back down the mountain and take the long way around.

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: Even though the demons' contamination spreads without end, we have no choice but to continue our journey through the mountains, and through the pass guarded by your warriors.

steps.name: Sami Mountain Scout
steps.text: Supplies? You only have the southerners' shortcomings to blame. They claim the land a barren wilderness, which is why they find themselves unable to survive in nature.

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: I'm simply asking that you—

steps.name: Typhon
steps.text: *sigh* Let's go, Simone.

steps.name: Typhon
steps.text: You don't owe them an explanation.

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: Wait, that hand signal... Are you for real?

steps.name: Typhon
steps.text: Yeah, trust me.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: —Just hold on a moment!

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Ugh... So bitter... *cough*... Let me explain!

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: I'm not a bad guy, I'm just an explorer! The only thing in these crates are reserve drones. I can open them up if you want a look!

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: I'm not trying to sneak into the icefield, either. I just didn't know how to get in touch with the Sami government to submit an application!

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Er, wait, does Sami have a government? I haven't actually seen anything resembling one, but...

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: But I do have the documents I was going to hand over to Ursus. My ID, exploration permit, and the abandoned route plans... They all prove that I'm just an explorer, nothing more.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Anyway, Simone and Typhon have both been so nice to me. Please don't blame them! If it's me that you're suspicious of, I'll explain everything!

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Also...

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Huh?
She's not imagining things.
Everyone's expressions grow increasingly solemn with every word she says.
They're all looking behind her, as though they too can hear her hallucinations.

steps.name: Typhon
steps.text: Run, you birdbrain!

steps.name: Typhon
steps.text: You brought an omen of disaster right into the group!

steps.name: Typhon
steps.text: This way!

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: Is this the path you mentioned?

steps.name: Typhon
steps.text: That's right.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Ah—That was close! The arrow hit the rock!

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Thanks, rock! Thanks, Fjal Vetrtonn!

steps.name: Typhon
steps.text: They probably mistook it for one of us, in this thick snowfall.

steps.name: Typhon
steps.text: Your Arts come in handy, Simone. I knew I could trust you to keep us hidden.

steps.name: Typhon
steps.text: Okay, now this way.

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: It's gotten quieter.

steps.name: Typhon
steps.text: Mm... Let me check. Yeah, I don't see them anymore.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Good! We shook them off!

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: Or perhaps... they stopped giving chase.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Whatever the case, we should be safe now, right?

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Phew... Hah...

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: All of a sudden... I'm outta breath...

steps.name: Typhon
steps.text: Give me your hand. I'll help you.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Th-Thanks... The expedition equipment and my protective gear are all just too heavy. When they designed this extreme north exploration gear, they probably didn't think we'd need to run in the mountains...

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: No, wait... I need to apologize!

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: I couldn't hear anything earlier, but it looked like you were bickering because of me. And then I got ahead of myself and started shouting.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: The Director always tells me to think before I act, but... Maybe it's because I have no idea what's so scary about these hallucinations, but I didn't really think that through, did I?

steps.name: Typhon
steps.text: No need to apologize.

steps.name: Typhon
steps.text: Nature doesn't debate right and wrong. All that matters is closeness. The same goes for those northern warriors just now.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Uh... closeness...?

steps.name: Typhon
steps.text: They're just like, mm... like a chain of mountains. No matter what you say to them, you will never become part of the mountains. All you can do is try your hardest to surmount them.

steps.name: Typhon
steps.text: Of course, you also can't tell the mountains that they're wrong and should be flat ground instead.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Ehh?

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Why are they so unwilling to talk it out?

steps.name: Typhon
steps.text: Let's set aside whether they could even understand you. Those warriors normally have no need for words.

steps.name: Typhon
steps.text: See, if you and I lived together all day, every day, and everything we did was the same daily routine: patrolling, hunting, fighting... We wouldn't have much reason to talk.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Hm, because we'd be too used to everything?

steps.name: Typhon
steps.text: No. Because communication is only needed when we think different thoughts.

steps.name: Typhon
steps.text: That's why I called them a chain of mountains.

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: Besides, they have to deal with the Ursus, too.

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: To them, they must be wary of any outlanders whose intentions they cannot discern at a single glance.

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: It may seem a little cruel, but it's how they have to live... (In Sami) 'One must accept fate, no matter what form it takes.'

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: (In Sami) Fate... hm.

steps.name: Typhon
steps.text: What's done is done. The signal I gave back there was for Simone to run. When you're dealing with those warriors, most of the time you're going to have to back down. You can't count on them giving way.

steps.name: Typhon
steps.text: That said, now we can't reach the icefield to find your teacher.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: *sigh* Yeah...

steps.name: Typhon
steps.text: So what are you going to do now?

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: I guess... I'll go to Čappat to request help.

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: That's the southernmost city in Sami, isn't it?

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Yeah, it's where a lot of Columbian companies have their only branch offices in Sami.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Now that the Ursus route is sealed off, it's the only place the Exploration Society can mount a rescue from.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: I'll rendezvous with them and try my best to collect information on the route. After all, nobody's really all that familiar with Sami.

steps.name: Typhon
steps.text: I'll keep escorting you, then.

steps.name: Typhon
steps.text: I don't need payment. I have no use for most of the trinkets southerners offer. I just happen to have a client waiting for me in Čappat.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Whoa, thanks!

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: What about you, Simone?

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: I promised I'd stay with you, didn't I?

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Ehehe.

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: But Typhon, where does this path lead?

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: I find it hard to imagine that there are still paths in this mountain that the scouts haven't discovered.

steps.name: Typhon
steps.text: That's because this takes us to where Arges lives.

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: ...A Cyclops's cave.

steps.name: Typhon
steps.text: Yeah, I guess it's my home, too. At least, I grew up there.

steps.name: Typhon
steps.text: I may have used Sarkaz Arts to cover our tracks, but any veteran shaman is bound to figure it out in an instant. But I doubt they'd want to disturb a Cyclops.

steps.name: Typhon
steps.text: Heh, no one likes hearing the prophesized tragedies doomed to befall them, after all.

steps.name: Typhon
steps.text: If they'd kept chase, I'd have to count on Arges being home to help us out. Luckily they weren't so patient.

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: This is making me feel uneasy, though.

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: They gave up far too easily. Almost as if they abandoned us in the snow.

steps.name: Typhon
steps.text: There's nothing to fear; I'm watching our surroundings.
The snow creaks beneath their feet.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Oh right... The disaster you two mentioned earlier... What's that all about?

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: If we're able to find the source of the auditory hallucinations and bring back samples to Rhine for analysis, maybe we could find a more long-term remedy!
Neither of them answer Magallan right away. Instead, the sound of their boots sinking into the snow grows louder by the step.

steps.name: Typhon
steps.text: What a strange question. Do you people think that Catastrophes, the cold, or the fangs of a mangler will just up and disappear one day?

steps.name: Typhon
steps.text: The disaster is relatively less common, but if it comes knocking on your door, you cannot defeat it.

steps.name: Typhon
steps.text: Hm, just like now.
The sound of their footsteps in the snow stops. While she wasn't paying attention, the snow had become light as a feather. Magallan blinks and does a double take.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: A-Am I hallucinating again, or is...

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: ...is it snowing upwards?

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: No, your eyes aren't deceiving you.

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: The snow is floating midair, above our heads.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: I... I need to gather samples!

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Give me a minute to activate the drones!

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: A snowflake that's still floating upward...

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Hah, got it! Next, snow that's accumulated midair...

steps.name: Typhon
steps.text: —Watch out!

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: The snow crumbles downward.

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: And from what I can barely make out given the visibility, there seems to be a lot more accumulated in the sky up ahead.

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: If we keep going, it's enough to bury all three of us once it comes crumbling down.

steps.name: Typhon
steps.text: This phenomenon must've been around for a while. They already knew about it, so they stopped giving chase. They knew we were prey driven into a dead end.

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: Not even a Snowpriest's Arts can do anything about this... and nor can I. Any snow I summon will only float upward and break free from my control.

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: —Wait, Magallan! Stay close to us! It's dangerous to go alone!

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: It's okay. I just need to get a little farther away to collect samples!

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: If the drones lose their balance while gathering and knock down the midair snow, only I'll be buried!

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: —Whoa, that was close!

steps.name: Typhon
steps.text: Do you feel it? The snow is trembling.

steps.name: Typhon
steps.text: Each step we take awakens it.

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: But a girl like her won't stop here.

steps.name: Typhon
steps.text: Give me your hand.

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: Hmm?

steps.name: Typhon
steps.text: Most people don't like doing this, but given the circumstances, we should give it a shot.

steps.name: Typhon
steps.text: Right, to make sure the blood flows onto the arrowhead, I'll need to cut a little deeper. But you don't need me to worry about you, right?

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: Do what you must, Typhon. Just don't cut too deep because our hands are numbed by the cold.

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: The snow's coming down more quickly.

steps.name: Typhon
steps.text: Yeah. The black seeds buried in the soil know my bow and arrows. This is exactly why people always misunderstand me.

steps.name: Typhon
steps.text: Okay, it's just Magallan left—

steps.name: Typhon
steps.text: —Magallan?! What's your status?

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Oh, I'm fine! It's just the snow fell down and blocked the path...

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Let me switch to the snow clearing module.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Okay! You two can come on over now!

steps.name: Typhon
steps.text: Give me your hand first. Take off your glove.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Er, gimme a bit of time to steel myself first.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: —Okay, here!

steps.name: Typhon
steps.text: That'll do it.
The arrow, soaked in the three women's blood, breezes through the cold wind. With a loud bang, an entire slab of frozen snow comes crashing down onto a cliff to the side.

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: ...Sarkaz witchcraft.

steps.name: Typhon
steps.text: The snow up to there won't fall anymore. I'll keep an eye out for the next place that looks dangerous and deal with it ahead of time in the same way.

steps.name: Typhon
steps.text: Let's keep going.

steps.name: Sami Forest Inhabitant
steps.text: I found a few more dead hornbeasts close to the spring water.

steps.name: Sami Forest Inhabitant
steps.text: We've followed the Samivilinn, the will of the land, and moved our entire tribe from the foot of the mountain all the way through the tundra.

steps.name: Sami Forest Inhabitant
steps.text: So why aren't we free of the disaster's corrosion yet?!

steps.name: Sami Forest Inhabitant
steps.text: We should try the divination one more time.... Just one more time, to see when the land will finally grant us peace.

steps.name: Sami Forest Inhabitant
steps.text: ...Or do you mean the Cyclops that traveled with us back then was telling the truth? That there would come a day when desolation would befall our tribe?

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Didn't you say that... somebody lived here?

steps.name: Typhon
steps.text: Yeah. And that I used to live here, too.

steps.name: Typhon
steps.text: *sigh* She's not here, as usual.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: But... Th-Th-This is a cave...

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Ah, too bad Simone had to leave because something came up... If she were here, she could tell me if this is normal or not...

steps.name: Typhon
steps.text: Hmm?

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Uh, nothing! Just wondering how I should describe this place in my notes.

steps.name: Typhon
steps.text: Whatever works for you.

steps.name: Typhon
steps.text: Here, jerky and salt. Arges isn't stingy. You can take whatever you want.

steps.name: Typhon
steps.text: Now we should have enough supplies to make it to the bottom of the mountain.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Thanks, Typhon, but hold on!

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: I don't know this Arges you're talking about. Seems a bit rude...

steps.name: Typhon
steps.text: Hm, she herself said, and I quote: (in Sarkaz) 'Anything with its curtain pulled open can be shared.'

steps.name: Typhon
steps.text: You can take that to mean she doesn't care.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Heh, well, don't mind if I do.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Also... is it okay if I make a detailed record of the cave in its current state?

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: I want to take a few pictures, too! I promise I won't make a mess!

steps.name: Typhon
steps.text: Why even ask? When you're done, come by the fire and rest.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Gotcha!

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Right, and can I look at these notes, too?

steps.name: Typhon
steps.text: Go ahead. Only she can understand what's in there anyway.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Okay... Huh?

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Right, Typhon, there's something I've been meaning to ask.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Logically speaking, when you hallucinate, you shouldn't hear any words you don't know, or any concepts you've never heard of, right?

steps.name: Typhon
steps.text: Hm, I'm not sure I follow your 'logic.' But what about it?

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Anyway, take a look at this page.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: 'When the box is opened, Andskotarnir will realize.'

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: That's the last thing I heard the Director say, before you helped me cut off the noise from my surroundings.

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: This Ursus communicator... It's getting a signal.

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: The question is... how long ago was it sent?

steps.name: Broken Transmission
steps.text: ...Reporting... to army... border guards...

steps.name: Broken Transmission
steps.text: With... the help of Liebafowl... Black Mark... in Sami...
